scope: Narrow current native qualification dispositions after authoritative metamodel cutover. Historical observations and current source-functional tests remain intact. This policy does not downgrade unrelated criteria or claim native equivalence.

criteria.rationale: Current source operations, retained native-payload equality and refusal controls remain separately tested. Exact historical artifact/source pins are only partly revalidated; current native admission and all-priority delivery are not established by live test citations.
